definitions.explanation: A sudden, brief burst of bright light. Used for lightning, camera flashes, explosions, and figuratively for sudden flashes of insight or inspiration.

examples.japanese: {閃光|せんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: A flash of light shot across.

examples.japanese: ⟦{稲妻|いなずま}→稲妻：04989_inazuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閃光|せんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{照|て}らした→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: A flash of lightning lit up the night sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閃光|せんこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{衝撃波|しょうげきは}→衝撃波：25944_shougekiha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{襲|おそ}って→襲う：01915_osou⟧きた。
examples.english: Simultaneously with the flash of the explosion, a violent shockwave hit.

notes:
Compound of {閃|せん} (to flash/glint) + {光|こう} (light). Describes an intense, instantaneous burst of light.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閃光|せんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (a flash runs/streaks)
- {閃光|せんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧ (a flash shines)
- {閃光弾|せんこうだん} (flashbang; flash grenade)
- {閃光|せんこう}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧ (like a flash — used for speed)

USAGE:
More dramatic and literary than simply saying ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧ (light). Conveys the sudden, intense quality of the flash. Also used in compound {閃光弾|せんこうだん} (flashbang). Be careful not to confuse with the many other せんこう homophones: ⟦{先行|せんこう}→先行：03773_senkou⟧ (precedence), ⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧ (major/specialty), ⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧ (incense).
